prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Try hiding and summoning your pet on your desktop right now before finishing setup.", "1. Press Hotkey to Hide Pet  2. Click Tray Icon to Summon Pet  3. Drag Pet to Preferred Corner", "Test Summon Gesture"]
1: ["Practice Quick Commands Now", "Learn how to instantly call or mute your pet with quick keyboard shortcuts.", "Press Option+P to toggle visibility | Press Option+M to mute voice", "Complete Practice"]
2: ["Final Setup & Audio Test", "Proceed to Audio Test", "Test Pet Speech & Microphones", "Say hello to your desktop pet to verify sound response and mic input.", "Test Pet Voice Output", "Finish Onboarding"]
3: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Scroll through pet companion styles to discover your perfect desktop friend.", "Standard Companion vs Custom Photo Pet"]
4: ["Secure & Preserve Your Pet Account", "Signing in locks your pet's identity, customization, and progress safely to your cloud profile so you never lose them.", "Your pet is instantly saved upon sign in."]
5: ["Building 3D Assets & Desktop Shaders...", "Tip: Your pet will appear in the top-right corner of your desktop screen when ready."]
6: ["Official Adoption Seal: Photo features and pet traits verified for desktop rendering.", "Verified Desktop Ready Seal"]
7: ["Practice Docking: 1. Click Tray Icon  2. Select 'Pin to Top'  3. Drag to Side", "Complete Setup"]
8: ["Sign In to Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Cloud Pet Storage Enabled"]
9: ["We will play a pleasant chime and send a desktop alert when your pet is ready!"]
